notes.title: A thoughtful match takes a little conversation.
items: Applicants must be at least 18 years old.
Some bonded cats need to be adopted together; their listing will explain this.
If a cat is adopted before we connect, your application can still help us find another match.
Our cats live in foster homes. Visits are arranged after application approval.
